properties.description: Synthetic engineering reference; native validation required before enablement.
properties.query:
let Evaluation = now();
let E = tolong((Evaluation - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1s);
let Rows = materialize(
    DetectionEvents_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= Evaluation - 30m
    | where TimeGenerated < Evaluation
    | where quality == "valid" and schema_version == 1
    | where event_time >= E - 1800 and event_time < E
    | where ingest_time <= E
    | summarize Hashes=make_set(payload_hash, 2),
        arg_min(ingest_time, *) by tenant, source, event_id
    | where array_length(Hashes) == 1
    | extend EventRef=strcat(tenant, "|", source, "|", event_id)
);
let Candidates = Rows
| where outcome == "success" and isnotempty(session)
| where (source == "identity" and action == "privileged_grant")
    or (source == "application" and action == "export");
let AliasRows = DetectionAliases_CL
| project tenant, alias, canonical_principal,
    valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, enrichment_version;
let Resolution = Candidates
| join kind=leftouter (AliasRows) on tenant, alias
| extend InValidity=isnotempty(canonical_principal)
    and valid_from <= event_time and event_time < valid_to
| summarize Candidate=take_any(pack_all()),
    ValidCount=countif(InValidity),
    Resolved=take_anyif(canonical_principal, InValidity),
    Observed=min(observed_at),
    EnrichmentVersion=take_any(enrichment_version)
    by EventRef
| extend tenant=tostring(Candidate.tenant),
    principal=tostring(Candidate.principal),
    session=tostring(Candidate.session),
    source=tostring(Candidate.source),
    action=tostring(Candidate.action),
    event_time=tolong(Candidate.event_time)
| extend DependencyState=case(
    isnull(Observed), "missing",
    E - Observed > 900 or E < Observed, "stale",
    ValidCount == 0, "missing",
    ValidCount != 1, "ambiguous", "fresh");
let Starts = Resolution
| where DependencyState == "fresh"
| where source == "identity" and action == "privileged_grant"
| project tenant, principal=Resolved, session,
    ATime=event_time, ARef=EventRef, AVersion=EnrichmentVersion;
let Ends = Resolution
| where DependencyState == "fresh"
| where source == "application" and action == "export"
| project tenant, principal=Resolved, session,
    BTime=event_time, BRef=EventRef, BVersion=EnrichmentVersion;
let Complete = Starts
| join kind=inner (Ends) on tenant, principal, session
| where BTime > ATime and BTime <= ATime + 600
| where AVersion == BVersion
| project tenant, principal,
    signal_key=strcat("DET-004|", ARef, "|", BRef),
    first_event_time=ATime, last_event_time=BTime,
    event_refs=array_sort_asc(pack_array(ARef, BRef)),
    mode="complete", dependency_state="fresh",
    enrichment_version=AVersion;
let Degraded = Resolution
| where DependencyState != "fresh"
| project tenant, principal,
    signal_key=strcat("DET-004|", EventRef, "|unresolved"),
    first_event_time=event_time, last_event_time=event_time,
    event_refs=pack_array(EventRef), mode="uncorrelated",
    dependency_state=DependencyState,
    enrichment_version=EnrichmentVersion;
union Complete, Degraded
| extend detection_id="DET-004", version="1.0.0",
    severity="medium", confidence="observed-contract-match"
| extend TimeGenerated=unixtime_seconds_todatetime(last_event_time)
| project TimeGenerated, detection_id, version, signal_key,
    tenant, principal, first_event_time, last_event_time,
    event_refs, mode, dependency_state, enrichment_version,
    severity, confidence
